- Committed the boundary cleanup as 17e9b07 (Collapse docker inspect support boundary). The commit also included a pre-staged .ralph/evidence/logs.snippet.json from the existing index.
- Requested task switch ran successfully enough to update current/done summaries and send the completion email.
- task_switch again warned that .ralph/current_task.txt was missing during rm; this is already a known tracked bug from earlier progress, so no duplicate bug task was created.

- Read previous progress and the improve-code-boundaries skill, then inspected tests/ha/support for a single smell-1 boundary to collapse.
- Identified duplicated process execution wrappers: process::{run,run_in_dir} plus DockerCli::{run,run_in_dir} all funneled into one real implementation.
- Flattened that tree into one execution path carrying Option<&Path> for cwd, updated observer/sql and observer/pgtm call sites, and ran cargo fmt.
- Next: run make check, run cargo nextest validation, inspect diff, commit, append final progress, and task_switch.
